releases.name: v2.7.3 Even More Bug Fixes
releases.body:
- Updated chinese translation (thanks @SanBaiMing)
- Reverted a vision to its original quality to prevent users from crashing upon loading it. (Fixes #52)
- Restored music for a situation.
- Fixed various missing paths and missing objects within the files.
- Fixed some grammar/typo issues (thanks @Djagur)
releases.bodyZh:
- 更新中文翻译 (感谢 @SanBaiMing)
- 将一个模组恢复到原始质量，以防止用户在加载时崩溃。(修复 #52)
- 恢复了一个场景的音乐。
- 修复了文件中的一些缺失路径和缺失对象。
- 修复了一些语法/拼写错误 (感谢 @Djagur)

releases.name: v2.7.2 More Bug Fixes
releases.body:
- Updated Japanese and French translations (thanks @TRSasasusu and @cOa-Rex)
- No longer suffocate in ship when entering a place (Fixes #40)
- Fixed a few typos in text (Fixes #36, Fixes #39, and Fixes #42) 
- Added observe volumes in a few places (Fixes #37)
- Fixed post credits not working
- Rotating a gear too many times before an animation finished no longer softlocks you (Fixes #47)
- Translator tool no longer appears under certain conditions (Fixes #35 and Fixes #41)
- Fixed a signal appearing slightly above where it should (Fixes #44)
- Increased the identification radius of a signal
releases.bodyZh:
- 更新了日语和法语翻译（感谢 @TRSasasusu 和 @cOa-Rex）
- 进入某个地点时不再在飞船中窒息（修复 #40）
- 修复了文本中的几个拼写错误（修复 #36、修复 #39 和 修复 #42）
- 在几个地方添加了观察范围（修复 #37）
- 修复了片尾不显示的问题
- 动画完成前旋转齿轮过多不再导致软锁（修复 #47）
- 在特定条件下翻译工具不再出现（修复 #35 和 修复 #41）
- 修复了信号出现在应该出现位置的上方一点的问题（修复 #44）
- 增加了信号的识别半径

releases.name: v2.7.1 Bug Fixes
releases.body:
- Fixed a bug where a teleport would bring you to White Hole Station and softlock
- Changed a gear interface to actually spin when you use it
- Reworked custom items
- Fixed bug where multiple items didn't work because a field on them reverted to 0
- Updated Ship Log Map Mode
- Fixed an easter egg that was broken from last update
- Added a missing person to credits
releases.bodyZh:
- 修复了一个传送会将你带到白洞站并导致软锁定的bug
- 修改了一个装备界面，当你使用它时它会实际旋转
- 重新设计了自定义物品
- 修复了一个bug，由于某个字段恢复为0导致多个物品无法工作
- 更新了飞船日志地图模式
- 修复了一个自上次更新以来就损坏的彩蛋
- 在鸣谢中添加了一个失踪人员

releases.name: v2.7.0 Alt Ending
releases.body:
- NEW ALT ENDING
- NEW PUZZLES AND SHORTCUT
- Updated translations for new stuff (thanks @Barirn, @nice2cu1, @TRSasasusu, @WrierBrake, and @coa_rex)
- Added translators to credits.
  - I have no idea why they weren't there. I blame anon (lol)
- Fixed a door that made a loud noise any time it opened
- Various minor bug fixes
releases.bodyZh:
- 新的终极结局
- 新的谜题和捷径
- 新内容的翻译更新（感谢 @Barirn, @nice2cu1, @TRSasasusu, @WrierBrake, 和 @coa_rex）
- 在鸣谢中添加了翻译者。
  - 我不知道他们为什么之前不在。我怪匿名者（哈哈）
- 修复了一扇每次打开都会发出巨大噪音的门
- 各种小错误修复

releases.name: v2.6.0 Translations
releases.body:
- Added missing simple chinese translations by @nice2cu1
- Added french translation by cOa Rex
releases.bodyZh:
- 添加了@nice2cu1缺失的简体中文翻译
- 添加了cOa Rex提供的法语翻译

releases.name: v2.5.2 Hotfix
releases.body: thanks to nh now supporting this feature, i have finally put a working speed limiter volume around a certain planet people were having troubles landing. that's it.

releases.name: v2.5.1 New Horizons Compatibility Patch
releases.body:
- fixes a bug where the latest new horizons update caused me to need to change my configs for certain areas regarding electricity
- makes the rafts on a certain planet have the cleaner version of the materials as they should be
- a certain vision torch can now be seen in simulation mode

releases.name: v2.5.0 Japanese Translation + Hotfix
releases.body:
- the stranger they are is now available in japanese!
- all translations fixed and up to date
- fixes translation error for custom items
- fixes audio volumes in one of the archives
- fixed that bug on the eye finally, which means a certain friendly face will not be waiting for you any longer.
- fixes some things related to solanum
- a certain storm's scale has been adjusted to not expose what's inside (finished)
- fixes a handful of null reference exceptions
- a certain vision torch can now be viewed from the bottom of a stairwell
- fixes a log condition not working properly for a certain deserted traveler

releases.name: v2.4.4 Hotfix
releases.body: - fixes a bug where a certain location wasn't properly translated in english

releases.name: v2.4.3 Hotfix
releases.body:
- you can no longer fly over a certain deadly windstorm and cheese half the mod
- slate now gives you advice on how to land on a certain planet
- english.json and diff.txt updated for translators, new slate dialogue needs translating.
- the absence of achievement names and descriptions has been fixed
